description:
Cast Awaken the Woods by paying {6}{G}{G}, creating six 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
The Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio six times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Lore Drakkis from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Activate all Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding six {G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Forest Dryads, adding {2}{U/R}{U/R}.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, mutating it on top of a Forest Dryad.
Lore Drakkis triggers, returning Awaken the Woods from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
